messages:
Priya: Quick sync — ACME asked for a 12mo private offer with a $500k commit and ~18% discount plus hardware SKU credits. Need decision on commit floor and SKU conversion mapping before legal drafts.
Rafael: Can we confirm expected ARR uplift? If their current spend is ~$30k/mo, $500k/yr is a big jump; want to align incentives.
Jess: FYI partner is bundling our reserved capacity + their appliance. They expect HW credit to cover first 3 months.
Ethan: Rough math — $500k/12 = ~41.7k/mo. If baseline is 30k/mo, uplift is ~11.7k/mo. That feels like a medium-risk on ramp. Do we require usage milestones?
Priya: Good point. I was thinking: commit floor = 60% of committed $ in year 1 as guaranteed consumption to avoid free riding. Thoughts?
Claire: 60% floor seems okay for HW-kicker deals. Suggest milestone-triggered top-ups: 60% guaranteed, 80% at month 6 if partner hits 70% attach rate.
Rafael: Agree, but need a simple conversion mapping for SKUs so finance can model credits. Example mapping request from partner: they want to trade appliance SKU AP-STD-1 for reserved capacity SKU RI-GPU-XL at 1:2 credit ratio.
Jess: That ratio seems high. Can we propose 1:1.5 and tie the rest to performance? Suggest: AP-STD-1 -> RI-GPU-XL : 1 => 1.5, AP-PRO -> RI-GPU-XL : 1 => 2.
Priya: I'll propose that in the draft. Also legal wants discrete milestones we can observe through Console metrics (routes + token-level).
Ethan: For the private offer discount ladder, propose tiers: 10% @ $250k, 15% @ $400k, 18% @ $500k. Always include renewal baseline that floors at last-year effective rate.
Rafael: Add rollback clause: if partner misses 2 consecutive quarterly milestones, discount drops by 3% and HW credits pause until remediation.
marketplace-bot: New private-offer draft created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/private-offers/PO-ACME-1735556667 (owner: Priya) :white_check_mark:
Priya: Nice — next steps checklist (copying here):
```
- Draft private offer (legal) — include 60% floor, discount ladder, rollback clause.
- SKU conversion table — finance to sign off on ratios.
- Observable metrics — eng to confirm routes + metrics for milestone triggers.
- HW credit ops playbook — ops to publish redemption flow and limits.
- Renewal clause — auto-roll to negotiated baseline unless 30d opt-out.
```
Jess: I'll run the SKU conversion by Fin and post comments by EOD.
Claire: Ops can draft the redemption flow tomorrow, will add rate limits and anti-fraud checks.
Ethan: Eng: can we guarantee the route-level metrics are in Console by next Tue? If not, we need a manual measurement plan.
Priya: If eng can't, we revert to partner-provided telemetry with weekly audit for first 2 quarters.
Rafael: OK — please update the private-offer draft with these bullets. I can champion the finance side in the approval thread.
Priya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the draft and ping legal/finance. If we can get sign-offs by Fri, we aim to send partner a term sheet next Mon. :rocket:
